title: Adaptive Machine Operator — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. PROPOSED CAPABILITY TARGET. This record describes a proposed future-grade capability target from the source paste. It is a specification of what such a tool would do, NOT a claim that it has been implemented, tested, or proven. A tool specification alone does not make an otherwise impossible technology achievable. Some entries build on existing research; others would require major scientific breakthroughs, new hardware, or extensive engineering. Adjusts machine settings in response to sensor feedback and verified operating limits. A proposed operator that runs machines the way a skilled human would: watching sensor feedback, adjusting settings within verified operating limits, and responding to changing conditions — never exceeding the limits that were validated for the equipment.
capabilities: Monitor sensor feedback continuously
Adjust settings within verified operating limits
Respond to changing material or environmental conditions
Enforce hard limits that adaptation cannot cross
Log every adjustment with its justification
